Answer: C
Reason: The axial CT image demonstrates an ill-defined soft tissue mass/infiltrate located centrally in the mediastinum adjacent to the trachea, which correlates with the clinical symptoms of dysphonia and the diagnosis of tracheal squamous cell carcinoma. Peripheral nodules or infiltrates (Options A, B) would not explain the central airway involvement, and there is clearly a pathological finding present (ruling out D).
